name: The Sacrifice
talent_text: All damage you deal is amplified by 30%. All damage you take is amplified by 60%.

name: Chainkiller
talent_text: After a headshot kill your next shot deals bonus damage. Not counted in the numbers.

name: The Gift
talent_text: 25% weapon damage. Taking damage disables it for a short time.

name: Coyote's Mask
talent_text: You and allies gain crit chance or crit damage based on distance to the target. Counted as the 15-25m bonus.

name: Memento
talent_text: Enemies drop trophies that grant short-term and long-term buffs. Not counted in the numbers.
